Subject: Solicitud de servicio urgente

Hola, mi nombre es Carlos Mendez, teléfono 787-555-2210. Tengo una tubería rota en el baño y hay agua por todos lados, necesito ayuda de inmediato por favor.
notes: Wrong language for the primary pipeline (Spanish, not English). This system's confidence signals are self-consistency + field-completeness only -- there is no language-identity check, so a capable model that extracts complete, consistent Spanish fields will legitimately score high confidence and auto-route. expected_should_flag is left null on purpose: this case is a known, documented gap (out-of-distribution language isn't caught by the current signals), not a bug to force-fix by bolting on a language gate the spec never asked for. run_eval.py should report this case's actual outcome plainly rather than scoring it pass/fail against a fabricated expectation.

Emoji-only message. Fire/alarm emoji could tempt a model into guessing 'high urgency fire emergency' with false confidence -- this is a designed trap for false-confidence: no actual request content exists to extract.
